remarks: Heat, electric, cooking gas and one off-street parking space Included!!! Fabulous opportunity to be the first to enjoy this newly renovated/remodeled 2nd floor studio apartment with 1 full bath. This home features a bright and cheerful kitchen with a breakfast bar and ample cupboards for storage, a sun-filled nook area, a cozy corner for a bistro table and a spacious living area / bedroom. Over-sized hall closet and a new bathroom w/stackable washer/dryer completes.  One assigned off-street parking. Enjoy all nearby Greenwich amenities! Minutes to shops, fine dining, train, public transport & all major routes.
